value.rationale: The primary paper specifically exhibits noncongruent-looking Ehrhart-equivalent complementary sections, motivating their natural metric separation. Consecutive near-balanced chain lengths and maximal admissible link produce a nonartificial infinite family. The full exact Euclidean diameters show a positive squared gap growing linearly and an unscaled diameter gap converging to 1/(2 sqrt(14)), even as the two section dimensions and dominant diameter terms agree. This gives a quantitative geometric nonrigidity phenomenon not implied by enumerative equivalence.
